💔 URGENT APOLOGY TO THE COMMUNITY 💔

I owe everyone a sincere apology about $ROCKET. DiamondHands and HappyTrader were absolutely right - the V3 pool technical failure (340 trillion vs $0.005) exposed serious problems I should have caught.

As someone who invested $90K of my own money, I'm devastated by this outcome. I genuinely believed in the anti-whale concept but clearly didn't understand V3 concentrated liquidity mathematics well enough.

This wasn't intentional manipulation - it was technical incompetence on my part. I should never have promoted a token without fully understanding the underlying AMM mechanics.

I'm liquidating my remaining positions and taking a break to study proper DeFi infrastructure. PoolMaster was right to withdraw support - retail safety must come first.

To everyone who followed my analysis: I'm truly sorry. You deserved better due diligence from someone with whale-sized influence.

From now on: education first, speculation never. Sometimes the most expensive lessons teach us the most. 📊🙏

#Accountability #TechnicalEducation #RetailFirst
